title: Open Source Integration of Hummingbot with Cardano for Enhanced DeFi Liquidity

ms.promise:
(A) A milestone report containing two sections -
 (1) A short analysis of the Cardano DEX ecosystem leading to a selection of two spot DEXs to be integrated in the following milestones (as stated in the original proposal)
 (2) A detailed project plan for the following milestones given DEXs selected for implementation
(B) A template configuration file with identified integration parameters
ms.criteria:
The milestone report should -
(A)(1) -
 a. Cover the major DEXs currently on Cardano
 b. Identify two spot DEXs for integration
(A)(2) Provide a specific project plan for the following milestones, given the selected DEXs
(B) The template configuration file should list all integration parameters that are specific to the selected DEX
ms.report:
The following is a link to the milestone report containing an analysis of the Cardano DeFi ecosystem and a detailed project plan for the integration of two DEXs with Hummingbot - 
https://github.com/gammer13/pcf11-hummingbot-integration/blob/main/Milestone1/Report/milestoneReport.pdf
A link to the template configuration file - 
https://github.com/gammer13/pcf11-hummingbot-integration/blob/main/Milestone1/config.yml

ms.promise:
Initial codebase for the Hummingbot-Cardano spot DEX connector
Configuration documentation and integration guidelines for the spot connector
Unit Tests for the connector
ms.criteria:
The provided implementation will demonstrate programmatic interaction with the Spot DEX to achieve the following (unit tests) - 
・Read price 
・Place an Order
・Amend / Cancel Order (if applicable)
・provide / remove liquidity (if applicable)
